title: Iran’s Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters:
text:
Iran’s Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters:"

"The baseless claims made by the United States regarding the normal passage of vessels through the Strait of Hormuz are nothing more than lies and falsehoods."

"It is hereby announced that the Strait of Hormuz, as before, is under the complete management and control of the Islamic Republic of Iran, and no commercial or oil tanker can transit this strait safely without the authorization and supervision of Iran's powerful armed forces, and this will continue to be the case."
